2. Same data but aggregated yearly.
3. Stock market data for Microsoft for past 60 days and past 120 days.

We have two functions: corporate_finance_dividend_data and stock_market_data. We need to call corporate_finance_dividend_data twice: once with frequency "quarterly" and once with default (annual). Then call stock_market_data twice: once with days=60 and once with days=120.

We need to produce function calls in JSON format. The user wants the data. We should call the functions accordingly. The user didn't specify any other constraints. So we will call corporate_finance_dividend_data twice and stock_market_data twice. The function calls must be separate calls. The user wants the data. So we will call the functions. The user wants the data for Microsoft. So we will call corporate_finance_dividend_data with company="Microsoft" and years=5, frequency="quarterly". Then corporate_finance_dividend_data with company="Microsoft" and years=5, frequency omitted or default. Then stock_market_data with company="Microsoft" and days=60. Then stock_market_data with company="Microsoft" and days=120.

We need to produce function calls. The user wants the data. So we will call the functions. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we will produce the function calls.
